findings.red: Worker DSN denylist is user/username/role/options/session_authorization only. Node-pg pg-connection-string last-wins query host/hostname/port/database/dbname/service (and encoded, mixed-case, duplicate, whitespace lookalikes) can change the live connect target while URL identity comparison still sees the authority host. Example: postgres://wolfhouse@decoy/db?host=127.0.0.1 connects as app owner to loopback; localhost vs 127.0.0.1 vs ::1 and default port 5432 are not canonicalized. passfile/ssl cert query refs are path/secret ambiguity.
findings.green: Worker DSN allowlist is empty: any query string is rejected, including host/hostname/hostaddr/port/database/dbname/service/user/username/role/options/session_authorization/passfile/sslcert and unknown keys, encoded, mixed-case, duplicate, and whitespace tricks. App and worker identities use pg-connection-string@2.13.0 assignment semantics (query host/user/port last-wins; pathname database) without executing ssl/file side effects. localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 and default port 5432 canonicalize for distinctness. Pre-connect comparison remains not live session proof. Passwords never leak.

findings.red: inspectEmailLunaAutomationShadowWorkerSession reads binding.client_id/location_id/location_key by property access, so a getter or Proxy can feed SQL params.
findings.green: Inspect copies/validates plain own scalar binding into a null-prototype structure before query. Getters, proxies, and non-plain bindings fail closed without querying.

findings.red: Operator preflight always labels inspect_authenticity=dedicated_worker_session, including when inspect_failed is true or the dedicated connection could not be created/used.
findings.green: inspect_authenticity=dedicated_worker_session only after a successful authentic inspect (inspect_failed is not true). Failure labels inspect_failed and never implies authenticity. ok cannot be true without dedicated_worker_session.

findings.red: pool.end() may never settle after clients are force-removed on close timeout.
findings.green: Documented residual: close timeout force-removes remaining clients and returns timeout without awaiting pool.end(). Bounded termination is verified; force-close is not live socket proof and must not be waited on.
